active_site_window_ablation_rule.pooling_rule: mean-pool residue tokens over merged eligible windows
active_site_window_ablation_rule.window_rule: Use +/-64 residues around allowed residue positions for ESM-C, ESM-2, ProtT5/local models, and SaProt/3Di variants where applicable

active_site_pooling_contract_excerpt.artifact_requirement: Every model artifact must state pooling_mode as whole_sequence, known_active_site_window_ablation, predicted_or_source_free_pocket, or unavailable
active_site_pooling_contract_excerpt.comparison_rule: Do not compare active-site-pooled models against whole-sequence models as if they used the same evidence budget; report them separately
controlled_ablation_only_inputs: pre-existing curated catalytic-residue annotations may be used only as known_active_site_window_ablation, not as the primary representation benchmark
active_site_pooling_contract_excerpt.evidence_budget_rule: Active-site pooling must be consistent across representation models and must not leak labels

structure_or_pocket_pooling_rule.selection_rule: Pool residues within 10 Angstrom of catalytic or pocket atoms when coordinates are available from an allowed source

active_site_pooling_contract_excerpt.whole_sequence_rule: Primary benchmark uses whole-sequence embeddings first for every representation family

foldseek_full_structure_command_plan.output_mapping_rule: map Foldseek raw query/target names by coordinate stem, allowing a trailing chain suffix such as pdb_1ABC_A -> pdb_1ABC
foldseek_full_structure_command_plan.query_scope: all currently materialized selected-coordinate files in artifacts/v3_foldseek_coordinates_1000
foldseek_full_structure_command_plan.target_scope: same selected-coordinate sidecar; metrics parser must score heldout query entries against in_distribution targets only

metadata.input_leakage_contract: no EC/name/prose/expert-note fields used as predictive features
predictive_feature_scope: selected-PDB/AFDB coordinates for Foldseek full-structure similarity
existing resolved active-site residue coordinate eligibility for controlled pocket ablation only

blockers: no track-specific pocket CIF sidecar exists yet
pocket extraction must preserve chain/residue provenance and covered_residue_count per active-site pooling contract
Foldseek full-structure NN should be compared separately from pocket-restricted NN because evidence budgets differ
pocket_nn_command_plan.planned_scope_when_unblocked: extract 10A neighborhoods around eligible resolved active-site residues from selected-PDB/AFDB coordinates, then run Foldseek easy-search over pocket CIFs with the frozen split parser
